_readme: Every message Leihlo shows or speaks comes from this file. The app never generates text.
english: English text. sepedi: Sepedi (Northern Sotho) text. If sepedi is blank the app shows English.
sepedi_source: "human" for lines written by the team, "machine_draft" for drafts that still need review by a native speaker. Change it to "human" once a line is checked.
audio: the recorded Sepedi clip. Only entries with spoken true are played. Optional English clips go in /audio/en/{key}.mp3.
Words in curly brackets, like {count}, are filled in by the app. Keep them as they are.
Do not use em dashes or en dashes.

strings.english: Leihlo helps you check your coffee leaves.
strings.sepedi: Leihlo o go thuša go lekola matlakala a gago a kofi

strings.english: Your name, photos and results are saved on this phone.
strings.sepedi: Leina la gago, dinepe le dipoelo di bolokilwe mo founong ye

strings.english: Your reports go only to your extension officer.
strings.sepedi: Dipego tša gago di ya fela go mohlankedi wa gago wa katoloso.

strings.english: You can delete all your data at any time in My reports.
strings.sepedi: O ka phumola data ya gago ka moka nako efe goba efe ka dipegong tša Ka

strings.english: Type your name, member number and plot name.
strings.sepedi: Thaepa leina la gago, nomoro ya leloko le leina la ploto.

strings.english: Which part of the plot are you checking?
strings.sepedi: Ke karolo efe ya plot yeo o e lekolago?

strings.english: Take a photo of the first leaf.
strings.sepedi: tsea senepe sa lekhasi la pele

strings.english: Take a photo of the second leaf.
strings.sepedi: tsea senepe sa letlakala la bobedi.

strings.english: Take a photo of the third leaf.
strings.sepedi: tsea senepe sa letlakala la boraro

strings.english: Hold one leaf flat in daylight, close to the camera.
strings.sepedi: Swara letlakala le tee le otlologile seetšeng sa letšatši, kgauswi le khamera.
Letlakala le le bonagala le phetše gabotse.

strings.english: This leaf may have coffee leaf rust.
strings.sepedi: Letlakala le le ka ba le bolwetši bja matheba a namune.

strings.english: This leaf may have leaf miner damage.
strings.sepedi: Letlakala le le ka ba le senyegile ka diboko tša matlakala.

strings.english: Not sure, ask the extension officer.
strings.sepedi: Ga ke na bonnete, botšiša mohlankedi wa katoloso.

strings.english: Keep checking your trees every week.
strings.sepedi: Tšwela pele o lekola mehlare ya gago beke le beke.

strings.english: Remove and destroy the affected leaves, then check the trees nearby.
strings.sepedi: Ntšha matlakala ao a amegilego o a fediše, ke moka o lekole mehlare ye e lego kgauswi.

strings.english: Remove and destroy the damaged leaves, and tell the cooperative.
strings.sepedi: Ntšha matlakala ao a senyegilego o a fediše, o be o botše mokgatlo.
Matlakala ka moka a mararo a bonagala a phetše gabotse.

strings.english: Some leaves may have coffee leaf rust.
strings.sepedi: Matlakala a mangwe a ka ba le bolwetši bja matheba a namune.

strings.english: Some leaves may have leaf miner damage.
strings.sepedi: Matlakala a mangwe a ka ba a senyegile ka diboko tša matlakala.

strings.english: Your report is saved and the extension officer will check it.
strings.sepedi: Pego ya gago e bolokilwe, mohlankedi wa katoloso o tla e lekola.

strings.english: The photo did not work, please try again.
strings.sepedi: Senepe ga se a šoma, hle leka gape.

strings.english: This deletes all your data from this phone.
strings.sepedi: Se se tla phumola data ya gago ka moka mo founong ye.

strings.english: The extension officer's eye on your farm.
strings.sepedi: Leihlo la mohlankedi wa katoloso polaseng ya gago.

strings.english: Mock mode: no model loaded. Leaf results are simulated.
strings.sepedi: Mokgwa wa teko: ga go na modele. Dipoelo tša matlakala ga se tša nnete.

strings.english: The model could not load. Mock mode: leaf results are simulated.
strings.sepedi: Modele ga o a kgona go bulega. Mokgwa wa teko: dipoelo tša matlakala ga se tša nnete.

strings.english: This result comes from the simulated classifier, not a real model.
strings.sepedi: Dipoelo tše di tšwa lenaneong la teko, e sego modeleng wa nnete.
Ga go na neteweke, e bolokilwe founong
{count} di bolokilwe, ga di eso romelwe
Go na le neteweke, ka moka di rometšwe

strings.english: Could not reach the server. Your reports are safe on this phone.
strings.sepedi: Ga re a kgona go fihla go seva. Dipego tša gago di bolokegile mo founong ye.

strings.english: Please fill in all three boxes.
strings.sepedi: Hle tlatša mafelo a mararo ka moka.

strings.english: This is not the final answer. The extension officer makes the final call.
strings.sepedi: Se ga se karabo ya mafelelo. Mohlankedi wa katoloso ke yena a dirago sephetho.
Ga go na ditekolo ga bjale.
Phumola data ya ka ka moka

strings.english: All your data is deleted from this phone.
strings.sepedi: Data ya gago ka moka e phumotšwe mo founong ye.

strings.english: This also removes your sent reports from the server, if the phone is online now.
strings.sepedi: Se se phumola le dipego tšeo o di rometšego go seva, ge founo e na le neteweke bjale.
Molaetša wo ga se wa nnete

strings.english: What the farmer gets on a basic phone.
strings.sepedi: Se molemi a se hwetšago founong ya gagwe.

strings.english: Your extension officer agrees with the app.
strings.sepedi: Mohlankedi wa gago wa katoloso o dumelelana le Leihlo.

strings.english: Your extension officer changed the app result.
strings.sepedi: Mohlankedi wa gago wa katoloso o fetotše dipoelo tša Leihlo.

strings.english: I will visit your farm soon.
strings.sepedi: Ke tla etela polase ya gago kgauswinyane.

strings.english: Please take clearer photos next time.
strings.sepedi: Hle tšea dinepe tše di bonagalago gabotse nakong ye e tlago.

strings.english: Please bring a leaf sample to the cooperative.
strings.sepedi: Hle tliša mohlala wa letlakala go mokgatlo.

strings.english: Good work, keep checking every week.
strings.sepedi: O šomile gabotse, tšwela pele o lekola beke le beke.

strings.english: Check each leaf. Confirm the app result or correct it.
strings.sepedi: Lekola letlakala le lengwe le le lengwe. Netefatša dipoelo tša Leihlo goba o di lokiše.

strings.english: Single device demo: reports made on this device appear here, even without a network.
strings.sepedi: Pontšho ya sedirišwa se tee: dipego tšeo di dirilwego sedirišweng se di tšwelela mo, le ge go se na neteweke.
Dinepe tše di nago le maina sedirišweng se: {count}
Ntšhetša ntle data ye e lokišitšwego
Ga go na dinepe tše di nago le maina ga bjale.
Dipego tše mpsha tše {count} go tšwa go seva.

strings.english: Could not reach the server. Showing reports on this device.
strings.sepedi: Ga re a kgona go fihla go seva. Re bontšha dipego tša sedirišwa se.
Ga go na dipego tše di emetšego.
Ga go na dipego tše di lekotšwego ga bjale.
Molaetša go molemi (ga se wa gapeletšwa)

strings.english: Confirm or correct every leaf first.
strings.sepedi: Netefatša goba lokiša letlakala le lengwe le le lengwe pele.

strings.english: Saved. The farmer's report is updated.
strings.sepedi: E bolokilwe. Pego ya molemi e mpshafaditšwe.

strings.english: Saved on this device. The server could not be reached.
strings.sepedi: E bolokilwe sedirišweng se. Ga re a kgona go fihla go seva.

strings.english: Leihlo looks at photos of coffee leaves on this phone and gives a first result with one next step.
strings.sepedi: Leihlo o lebelela dinepe tša matlakala a kofi mo founong ye, gomme o fa dipoelo tša mathomo le kgato e tee ye e latelago.

strings.english: It does not decide anything. The extension officer checks every report and makes the final call.
strings.sepedi: Ga a dire sephetho. Mohlankedi wa katoloso o lekola pego ye nngwe le ye nngwe gomme ke yena a dirago sephetho.

strings.english: Mock mode. No model files are installed, so a simple colour rule stands in for the model.
strings.sepedi: Mokgwa wa teko. Ga go na difaele tša modele, ka fao molao wo bonolo wa mebala o šoma legatong la modele.

strings.english: Results below {percent} percent confidence show as not sure.
strings.sepedi: Dipoelo tše di lego ka tlase ga diphesente tše {percent} tša bonnete di bontšhwa bjalo ka ga ke na bonnete.

strings.english: Training images: [dataset name and link, to be added]
strings.sepedi: Dinepe tša go ruta modele: [leina le linki ya data, go tla tlaleletšwa]

strings.english: Dataset size: [number of images per class, to be added]
strings.sepedi: Bogolo bja data: [palo ya dinepe ka mohuta, go tla tlaleletšwa]

strings.english: What the data does not cover
strings.sepedi: Seo data e sa se akaretšego

strings.english: The training photos were not taken on your farm.
strings.sepedi: Dinepe tša go ruta ga se tša tšewa polaseng ya gago.

strings.english: Light, coffee variety and local diseases here may be different.
strings.sepedi: Seetša, mohuta wa kofi le malwetši a lefelong le a ka fapana.

strings.english: The app only knows healthy leaves, coffee leaf rust and leaf miner. Anything else shows as not sure.
strings.sepedi: Leihlo o tseba fela matlakala a phetšego gabotse, bolwetši bja matheba a namune le diboko tša matlakala. Tše dingwe di bontšhwa bjalo ka ga ke na bonnete.

strings.english: The advice list is a draft. The extension service must check it before real use.
strings.sepedi: Dikeletšo tše ke tša mathomo fela. Tirelo ya katoloso e swanetše go di lekola pele di šomišwa.

strings.english: Your name, member number, plot name and photos are stored on this phone.
strings.sepedi: Leina la gago, nomoro ya leloko, leina la ploto le dinepe di bolokilwe mo founong ye.

strings.english: Reports are sent only to the extension officer's server. There are no ads and no tracking.
strings.sepedi: Dipego di romelwa fela go seva ya mohlankedi wa katoloso. Ga go na dipapatšo goba go latelwa.

strings.english: Exported training data has photos and labels only, with no names or member numbers.
strings.sepedi: Data ye e ntšhitšwego e na le dinepe le maina a mehuta fela, ga e na maina a batho goba dinomoro tša maloko.

strings.english: If the phone is lost or shared
strings.sepedi: Ge founo e lahlegile goba e abelanwa

strings.english: Anyone who opens the app on this phone can see your reports. Use Delete all my data before you hand the phone on.
strings.sepedi: Mang le mang yo a bulago Leihlo mo founong ye a ka bona dipego tša gago. Šomiša Phumola data ya ka ka moka pele o fa motho yo mongwe founo.

strings.english: If the phone is lost, ask the extension officer to remove your reports from the server.
strings.sepedi: Ge founo e lahlegile, kgopela mohlankedi wa katoloso go tloša dipego tša gago go seva.
E lokile go šoma ntle le neteweke.

strings.english: Still saving files for offline use. Open the app once on a network.
strings.sepedi: Re sa boloka difaele tša go šoma ntle le neteweke. Bula Leihlo gatee o na le neteweke.

strings.english: Some Sepedi text is a machine draft awaiting review by a native speaker.
strings.sepedi: Mantšu a mangwe a Sepedi a ngwadilwe ke motšhene, a emetše go lekolwa ke seboledi sa Sepedi.

strings.english: Prototype for the Small AI for Development hackathon.
strings.sepedi: Mohlala wa mathomo wa phadišano ya Small AI for Development.
